r0.why: Abstract sphere, arbitrary radius, concentric, projection, Earth/observer centre and hemispherical screen all in 1-3.

r1.why: Position without distance (4), no distance info (6), equal distance and westward rotation (7), direction-only indifference (8).

r2.why: Infinite radius (9), any point as centre (10), parallel lines and vanishing point (11), same view for all observers (14).

r3.why: Oversimplified (15), Moon shift (16), parallax as offset (17), centres (18), observers' own offsets (20).

r4.why: Shorthand used frequently (22), 2010 Almanac Moon coordinates (23), rough phase use (25), eclipse topocentric methods (26).

r5.why: Perfect and divine (28), concentric superlunary spheres (32), incorruptible by four elements (33), 27 vs 55 spheres (39-40).
